r.overdue_other: {{count}} tasks are overdue. Want me to move them to today?
r.expenses_none: No income or spending recorded this month yet.

r.expenses_near: You've spent {{spent}} this month. {{near}} is close to its budget.

slip.intro: Pick bank transfer slips or take a photo. Veyra reads the amount, date and payee and suggests the account and category — you confirm before anything is saved.
slip.needs_setup: Slip reading needs the Supabase project (EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL). Without it you can still fill each slip by hand.
slip.camera_denied: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings, or choose from photos instead.
slip.status_not_slip: Doesn't look like a bank slip
slip.status_offline: Couldn't read it — fill in by hand
slip.fix_errors: Some slips are missing an amount, account or date.
slip.wallet_digits_hint: The digits your slips show (xxx-x-x1234-x → 1234), used to match slips to this account.
